meta.title: Download the bid template and upload it filled
gaps: Fill 100 for every line in the downloaded bid template file
Upload the filled bid template using Upload Sheet
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Fill 100 for every line in the downloaded bid template file; Upload the filled bid template using Upload Sheet

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Continue in Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Attempt to download the bid template from the vendor bid sheet.
Assert that a bid-template file was downloaded.
Closest supported check for the expected outcome: fill every price cell with 100 and submit the bid directly through the vendor sheet.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the bid and shows it as submitted.
